entities.summary: Mikaela Loach is a British climate justice activist, author, and former medical student. She uses social media for campaigning, and has published two books, It's Not That Radical: Climate Action to Transform Our World (2023) and Climate Is Just The Start (2025). She was named as one of the Prospect top thinkers in 2024.
